prompts.background: Use case photorealistic-natural. ONE high-resolution photographic landscape, wide 3:2 canvas matching a 1920x1248 desktop scene composition. Calm first-person human eye level, fixed natural 35mm lens, level horizon. Soft natural illumination, realistic texture, moderate contrast and saturation, no HDR, no fantasy glow. A continuous believable space with a clearly visible route from bottom center toward a stopping place near x=50%, y=48%. This is a BACKGROUND PLATE for later multi-plane FFmpeg camera parallax: keep the central view open, do not include large close framing objects at the edges since these are separate layers. The image must fill every edge with scenery. No people, bodies, animals, signs, buildings, text, logos, watermarks, collage or panels. Snowy mountain landscape: unmistakable distant jagged SNOW-COVERED peaks, powder snow on gentle terrain, a few distant conifers at mid distance, blue-white morning shade and gentle warm morning light from upper LEFT. A shallow snow path leads from bottom center toward a FLAT snow viewpoint. Snow texture and subtle contours readable, not white blown out. No storm, no falling flakes, no ski resort, no dramatic cliff, no close branches.
prompts.middle: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY the lighting, texture, palette and eye-level perspective reference. Generate ONE independent middle-near parallax layer on a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Full wide 3:2 landscape canvas aligned with reference. Draw ONLY two photorealistic snow-covered low rocks with a small evergreen sapling cluster, confined to LOWER outer LEFT 18% and outer RIGHT 16% of the canvas. Sapling branches may rise halfway up at the outer edges, snow has subtle blue shade and warm upper-left light. Roots and rock bases continue beyond bottom edge; central corridor and upper center transparent. Match the reference with soft sunlight from upper LEFT, natural material detail and moderate contrast. Preserve CENTRAL 60% of width as completely transparent from top to bottom for an open pathway. No backdrop, no ground plane, no solid-color background, no fake checkerboard, no vignette; every pixel except actual objects is transparent. No people, animals, text, logo, watermark or collage. One cutout plate ready to composite over the reference, not a rendering of a finished combined scene.
prompts.near: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY a lighting, color and photographic texture reference. Generate ONE closest foreground layer with actual RGBA alpha transparency, wide 3:2 full canvas. Draw ONLY a few close evergreen needle tips with a dusting of soft snow, emerging from beyond the bottom outer corners. Only occupy bottom 22% and outer 16% each side, framing rather than blocking the snow path. No whole tree, no ground slab. Lighting matches reference: warm soft morning light from upper LEFT and natural gentle shadows. Everything above the lower corner foliage and the central 60% corridor must be completely transparent, not a blurry backdrop. Fine natural edges, no ground plane, no filled background, no solid color, no painted checkerboard, no vignette, no whole scene, no collage. No person, animal, text or watermark. Match the realism of the reference and keep the near plants modest so that they will slide outward as the viewpoint moves forward.
